title: Nvidia security questions raised following leadership departures
excerpt: Nvidia's security team faces scrutiny after the security chief left and CEO Jensen Huang stepped down amid relationship ties.
body_html:
Nvidia's security team is facing renewed questions following recent leadership changes at the company. The company's security chief quietly departed in August.

Meanwhile, CEO Jensen Huang has stepped down from his position. The departure follows relationships involving Huang, including one with an executive at a firm suspected of funneling chips to China.

According to a former intelligence officer, leaks of this nature often drive everyday conversations that standard corporate security teams are typically not equipped to catch.
